    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Mark the trailing background cells after a foreground run in each row.
    for row in out:
        fg=max(set(row), key=row.count)
        # ARC pattern rows use the dominant color as background; salient runs are minority.
        # Find a trailing background gap after foreground marks.
        bg=fg
        inds=[i for i,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
        if inds and inds[-1] < len(row)-1:
            for j in range(inds[-1]+1,len(row)):
                if row[j]==bg: row[j]=1
    return out
'''; open(p,'w').write(code)

    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for row in out:
        counts={x:row.count(x) for x in set(row)}
        bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
